source_plan: TMM_ngram_blocking_plan_v001.pdf (prespecified local study plan; not bundled)
purpose: Post-primary four-arm comparison of token n-gram blocking and the existing canonical character guard.

scope.extension_decision: Complete the prespecified minimal Primary/public n=4 comparison in this execution. No reference-based parameter selection.

arms.A: Reuse original V4 cap224 compression-triggered fallback, n=0, without character guard
arms.B: A plus original canonical character guard; validate against V5 texts
arms.C: New cap224 greedy and every fallback generation use no_repeat_ngram_size=4
arms.D: C plus exactly the same canonical character guard as B

batching.global_index: zero-based order of first occurrence of batch_id in the COMPLETE original V4 map, before subset selection

fallback.trigger: C own greedy text UTF-8 zlib compression ratio > 2.4
fallback.average_logprob_definition: Normalize generated.scores after removing temperature scaling; include first EOS and exclude subsequent padding. For no EOS divide by generated step count + 1. Scores represent the processed, n-gram-constrained distribution.

scoring.normalization: reuse canonical NFKC, lowercase, alphanumeric normalization
scoring.speaker_assignment: minimize error separately for each arm and complete recording
scoring.bootstrap_unit: recording, paired; resample numerators and denominators then recompute micro cpCER

input_recovery.original_audio: AISHELL-5 original 18 Primary recordings; all 72 far-field paths are present
input_recovery.activity_source: reuse original public Sortformer posterior arrays and metadata
input_recovery.frontend: reuse original streaming packet fullmeeting export implementation and original configuration
input_recovery.acceptance: 18 recordings, 1744 matching stream windows, 222 unchanged original batches; readable mono 16 kHz audio with matching lengths
input_recovery.baseline_reuse: A/B reused as authorized by the source plan when original recordings, activity source, enhancement, windows and decoding settings are retained

observed_environment_before_run.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU
